'''ar2dee2 Revenge of the Hutt''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ar2dee2]]
* '''Published:''' 5 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / Vile Gangsters|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif|label=Court Of The Vile Gangster}}
* '''Strategy:''' Court Of The Vile Gangster
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Vile ar2dee2 DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Mu hahhahahah <meniachal laugh> The Court of the vile slug!

The published list has 62 cards.
